## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--tillie-gammon.md)

Tillie Gammon is a schoolmate of [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) who supported [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) against their teacher. Their bond originated at school, where [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) defended herself against Hugh Carrow's teasing before deciding to leave the school entirely.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), +3 more_
